def test_payment_authorization():
    order_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

    payment_payload = {
        "address": {"city": "C", "country": "C", "number": "1", "postcode": "1", "street": "S"},
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234"},
        "customer": {"firstName": "F", "lastName": "L"},
        "orderId": order_id
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth = resp.json()
    assert auth["authorised"] is True
    assert auth["orderId"] == order_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 1
    assert auths[0]["authorised"] is True

def test_user_registration_and_login():
    username = random_string()
    password = random_string()
    email = f"{username}@example.com"

    reg_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": email,
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=reg_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=HTTPBasicAuth(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=reg_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=HTTPBasicAuth(username, "wrong"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_catalogue_and_cart_operations():
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    socks = resp.json()
    assert len(socks) > 0, "Expected at least one sock in catalogue"
    sock_id = socks[0]["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{sock_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["id"] == sock_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue/nonexistent-id"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    customer_id = random_string()

    item_payload = {
        "itemId": sock_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": 10.5
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == sock_id
    assert items[0]["quantity"] == 2

    update_payload = {
        "itemId": sock_id,
        "quantity": 5,
        "unitPrice": 10.5
    }
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=update_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{sock_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 5

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{sock_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{sock_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_cart_merge():
    session_id = random_string()
    customer_id = random_string()

    item_payload = {"itemId": "test-item", "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 5.0}
    requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == "test-item"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId=nonexistent"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_end_to_end_order_workflow():
    username = random_string()

    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json={"username": username, "password": "pwd", "email": f"{username}@test.com"}, timeout=10)

    addr_payload = {"city": "TestCity", "country": "TestCountry", "number": "123", "postcode": "12345", "street": "TestSt", "userID": username}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=addr_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json()["id"]

    card_payload = {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456", "userID": username}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json()["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    sock_id = resp.json()[0]["id"]

    requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json={"itemId": sock_id, "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 15.0}, timeout=10)

    order_payload = {
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    assert "id" in order
    assert order["customer"]["username"] == username
    assert order["status"] in ["CREATED", "PAID", "SHIPPED"]

    order_id = order["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["id"] == order_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer_orders = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert any(o["id"] == order_id for o in customer_orders)
